title: Pure domain logic: ids, rank (parity with Python), markup merge plan
description:
Pure domain logic for `apricitus-data`, with no storage engine: everything in `design/storage.md` §1.2, §1.3 and §1.5 that is a pure function. It's written now so it's ready when the engine arrives. `apricitus-data::domain` (task apricitus-9987a3) will call these.

## Crate
New `crates/apricitus-data` (workspace member), depending only on `apricitus-score`, `serde`/`serde_json`, `sha1`/`sha2`, `uuid`. No Virtuus dependency yet. Module `logic`:
- **`ids`:** `clip_id(audio_sha256) -> "clp_" + sha256[..20]`; `stem_clip_id(parent_id, stem, model) -> "clp_" + hex(sha256("parent|stem|model"))[..20]`; `candidate_id(clip_id, start, end, kind) -> "cand_" + hex(sha1(format!("{clip_id}|{start:.2}|{end:.2}|{kind}")))[..16]`; `curated_slice_id(candidate_id) -> "slc_" + hex(sha1(candidate_id))[..20]`; `migrated_slice_id(clip_id, name) -> "slc_" + hex(sha1("clip_id|name"))[..20]`. Unit tests with fixed expected strings.
- **`rank`:** a faithful port of `analysis/apricitus_analyze/curation.py` `rank()` and `_weight`/`_traits`/`TRAIT_WORDS` (the Beta(1,1) keep-rate lift per trait kind/proposer/recording/stem; low-star keeps weigh 0.4/0.7; "later" contributes nothing; later items last; the `why_ranked` strings, including the rule that "kept" needs a keep and "skipped" needs a skip). Input types: `Candidate { id, kind, recording, stem: Option, proposers: Vec<{by, score}> }`, `Verdict { verdict, stars }`. Output `Ranked { id, rank, why_ranked, later }`.
- **`markup`:** `iou(a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64)) -> f64`, plus `plan_merge(existing: &[ExistingSlice], proposed: &[Proposed], name_counters: &Map<kind, u32>, used_by_score: &Set<slice_id>) -> MergePlan { keep: Vec<(existing_id, new span, rank, evidence)>, create: Vec<(name, span, ...)>, retire: Vec<id>, delete: Vec<id>, name_counters }`, following §1.3 exactly: only active ML slices are matched; same kind; the best IoU ≥ 0.8 wins; each existing slice matches at most once; names `{kind}-{n}` with `n` = counter + 1, never reused. Make it greedy by descending IoU, and deterministic.

## Tests
- Unit tests for each function.
- **Rank parity:** `scripts/export-rank-fixture.py` (run with `analysis/.venv/bin/python`) loads `library/candidates.json`, makes a deterministic set of synthetic verdicts (e.g. keep every 7th, skip every 5th, stars on some, later on some), runs `curation.rank`, and writes `crates/apricitus-data/tests/fixtures/rank.json` (inputs plus expected order, ranks rounded to 1e-4, and `why_ranked`). A Rust test asserts identical order, ranks within 1e-4, and identical `why_ranked`.
- `markup` tests mirror `features/data/domain/markup_merge.feature` at the plan level.

## Verify
```
PYTHONPATH=analysis analysis/.venv/bin/python scripts/export-rank-fixture.py
cargo test -p apricitus-data
```

---
**Repo:** ~/Projects/Ripple (master). **Protocol:** initiative apricitus-e70662: specs/tests first; log with kbs comment; run Verify and paste the output; label ready-for-review. Never git add/commit/push/close/deploy. Toolchain: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; Python analysis/.venv/bin/python.

Regenerate the fixture, re-run cargo test -p apricitus-data, and paste the expected-length and reasons counts.

- Later: 21 candidates
